textContent: Private Guided Day Trip to Santiniketan  Tour Duration 12 hours (Flexible)  Easy Pickup Free hotel pickup & drop.  Language English  Tour Assistance Available free with every tour. About the Tour: Private Guided Day Trip to Santiniketan Explore one of India’s newest UNESCO World Heritage sites—and leave all the transit and planning to someone else—on this private, full-day trip from Kolkata to Santiniketan. Follow in the footsteps of Nobel Laureate Rabindranath Tagore as you explore Visva-Bharati University, his ashram, the Tagore Museum, and artisan markets. Learn insider stories along the way, and benefit from a flexible itinerary and included transportation. Tour Highlights: Private Guided Day Trip to Santiniketan Stop At: Tagore’s Ashram Stop At: Bichitra (Rabindra Bhavan) Stop At: Uttarayan Complex – Udayana, Konarka, Shyamali, Punascha and Udichi Stop At: Chhatimtala Pass By: Santiniketan (the abode of peace) Griha Pass By: Brahmo Mandir (Prayer Hall) Pass By: Visva Bharati University Stop At: Srijani Shilpagram Stop At: Shonibarer Haat khoai Stop At: Amar Kutir Why Kolkata Trips?  Free Tour Assistance Before booking till end of Tour, a dedicated Tour Assistant will be available.  Curated Experiences and Flexible Itineraries Discover Santiniketan with a Private guide, AC car with hotel pickup.  Hassle-Free Booking & Secure Payment Booking your tour with us is simple, secure, and convenient. We accept all major Credit and Debit Cards, making the payment process smooth and stress-free for our guests. Tour Cost USD 220 per guest.(minimum 2 guests are required or one willing to pay for two) Book Tour What is included? Customised Private Tour by Air-Conditioned Vehicle along with Govt. approved Professional Tour Guide. All essential Fees & Taxes as per the Itinerary, including Guide Fees, Fuel, Parking & Toll Charges. Refreshments & Packed Drinking Water. Hotel Pickup and Drop-off for a seamless travel experience. A scheduled lunch break (meal cost not included), giving you the flexibility to try local flavors. What is not included? Gratuities (at your discretion). Meals and personal expenses unless specified. Entry fee for the Tagore Museum is not covered. Posted on Tripadvisor Sophia 27 April 2026 Verified Perfect Heritage Escape – Best Bishnupur Day Trip from Kolkata We recently booked a Kolkata to Bishnupur one day tour package with Kolkata Trips, and it was one of the most rewarding cultural experiences we have had in West Bengal. What we appreciated most was how smoothly the day was managed. Despite covering so many important sites, the pace was comfortable, with enough time for photography, exploration, and local snacks. It felt like a true Bishnupur day trip designed for travelers who want quality experiences, not just rushed sightseeing. Posted on Tripadvisor Inspire59089999388 15 April 2026 Verified A Truly Enriching Journey to the Hidden Gems of Bishnupur We recently had the pleasure of experiencing the Hidden Treasures of Bishnupur – Private Day Tour from Kolkata with Kolkata Trips, and it turned out to be one of the most memorable cultural excursions I’ve taken in West Bengal. The journey begins early in the morning with a comfortable pick-up from Kolkata. Although the drive to Bishnupur takes around 3.5 to 4 hours each way, the scenic countryside—lush green paddy fields, rustic villages, and peaceful rural landscapes—makes the journey quite enjoyable and refreshing. What truly sets this tour apart is the depth of cultural immersion. Bishnupur is a treasure trove of heritage, famous for its stunning terracotta temples built during the Malla dynasty. Exploring iconic sites like Ras Mancha, Shyam Rai Temple, Jor Bangla Temple, and Madanmohan Temple was an absolute delight. The intricate terracotta carvings depicting mythological stories are simply breathtaking and offer a fascinating glimpse into Bengal’s rich artistic legacy. A special mention must go to the guide, whose knowledge and storytelling brought each monument to life. The historical context, architectural details, and cultural anecdotes added immense value to the experience. The tour is well-paced, allowing ample time at each site without feeling rushed, and the private setup ensures a very personalized and flexible experience. Another highlight was the opportunity to witness local craftsmanship, especially the famous Baluchari silk weaving. It added a unique dimension to the tour, connecting history with living traditions. Yes, it is a long day (approximately 12 hours), but every moment feels worthwhile. The comfort of an air-conditioned vehicle, seamless planning, and attentive service make the experience smooth and enjoyable throughout. Overall, this tour is perfect for anyone interested in history, architecture, and authentic cultural experiences. If you’re looking to explore beyond Kolkata and discover a lesser-known yet incredibly rich heritage destination, Bishnupur is a must-visit—and Kolkata Trips does a fantastic job curating this journey.
